jobs.title: Layered backend: server, domain, adapters, projects
jobs.description: 034-backend-layout: new docs/MVP.md §4.7 Code layout with the tree and rules below; FACTORY.md conventions and the review-code checks point at §4.7 (.claude/agents/review-code.md and the review-code factory template, §7.3). Tree under `src/claude_factories/`: `server/` (`create_app`, lifespan, the §4.5 middleware, domain error → HTTP mapping that keeps the `{"detail": …}` shape, `deps.py` providers), `controllers/` (one `APIRouter` per resource, plus `pages/` for the Jinja routes until 026), `handlers/` (use cases as plain functions, one module per resource), `dto/` (pydantic request and response models per resource), `repositories/` (all SQL, one module per table group), `adapters/` (`git.py` and `claude.py`, each a `Protocol` plus its subprocess implementation with argument lists), `domain/` (Status, Stage, and Reviewer enums, the §5.2 stage → status map, `NotFound` / `Conflict` / `TooLarge` errors), `lib/` (pure parsers and renderers: patch split, diff rows, run log, markdown, slug), `db/` (connection, `schema.sql`), `config.py` (env and limits), `cli/`. Rules: controllers → handlers → repositories and adapters; domain/ and lib/ import none of them; only server/ and controllers/ import fastapi, so handlers raise domain errors; handlers get repositories and adapters through `Depends`, so tests can swap in fakes; one handler call is one transaction. This job builds server/, config.py, domain/, db/, adapters/, and the deps, and moves workspaces, projects, and Create factory into the layers. app.py keeps the routes not moved yet, as a router that server/ includes. A pytest reads every module's imports with `ast` and fails on a wrong direction, on fastapi outside server/ and controllers/, or on SQL outside repositories/ and db/, with app.py exempt until 036.

jobs.title: fctl seed: demo data for every page and state
jobs.description: `fctl seed` fills an empty `FCTL_HOME` with demo data so every page and state in docs/ui.md §8 shows up without running an agent. It refuses (exit 1, `FCTL_HOME has data; seed an empty one`) when the DB has any workspace, so demo rows never mix with real ones: `FCTL_HOME=~/.claude-factories-demo fctl seed`, then `fctl serve` with the same `FCTL_HOME`. The seed lives in the §4.7 layers (rows through repositories, no SQL elsewhere), imported lazily by the CLI the way `fctl serve` is, with timestamps spread over the last 30 days. Demo git repos under `FCTL_HOME/demo/` (README, nested files, a few commits) back the code page and factory state: one project per state none / uncommitted / ready (§3.2) across two workspaces, one with `context_md`. Tasks cover every status and stage (§5.2): backlog with markdown descriptions; in_progress at each stage, one stalled; human_review after 2 rounds (CHANGES then all PASS, build notes, approver APPROVE); escalated with ESCALATE; rework after my CHANGES_REQUESTED; a standalone submit with "no agent review" (§7.4); done this week and earlier, so the dashboard tiles and rounds-per-task stats fill (§8 item 1). Round diffs are real `git diff` output from the demo repos through the 005 splitter, covering added, modified, deleted, renamed, and binary files; agent and my inline comments on both sides, plus conversation comments. Runs succeeded, failed with an error, and stopped, each with a stream-json log in `runs/`, so the log tail and takeover command show; no `running` run, since the startup cleanup marks it failed (§4.4). README "Demo data" section for host and Docker; a pytest seeds a temp `FCTL_HOME`, checks each `/api/pages/*` view shows the seeded states, and checks that a second seed refuses. After 029, so fctl.md gets a `seed` section.

jobs.title: Copy and show agent transcripts per run
jobs.description: on run exit, Stop, and the startup cleanup, copy the run's Claude Code transcripts from `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects/` (default `~/.claude`), in the folder Claude Code names after the worktree path: the main `<session_id>.jsonl`, its `subagents/agent-*.jsonl` with the agent type from `*.meta.json`, and teammate sessions such as the named builder. They go into `FCTL_HOME/transcripts/<run-id>/`, because Claude Code prunes old transcripts and the worktree gets removed. New table `transcripts` with run, task, agent type, name, the round from the `Job <id>, round <n>.` prompt when there is one, path, model, turns, and tokens (input, cache read, output, summed from `usage` deduped by message id), started and ended; `GET /api/tasks/{id}/transcripts`, `GET /api/transcripts/{id}` as parsed messages (text, tool calls with input, tool results cut at 4 KB with a "show all", thinking collapsed), and `/raw` to download; an Agents section per round on the task page (model, turns, tokens, duration) linking to a transcript page; transcript text escaped, markdown through the backend renderer with raw HTML off (§4.5); tests use a temp `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` with fixture transcripts, never the real `~/.claude`.

jobs.title: fctl import-factory: factory jobs into the app
jobs.description: `fctl import-factory [--job ID]` in this repo calls `POST /api/projects/{id}/import-factory`, and the app reads `<project path>/factory/` with path containment. Rerunning updates the rows instead of duplicating them, keyed on a new unique `tasks.import_key` (`factory:014-run-ui`). Mapping: board.json gives title, description, status, stage, branch, done_at, and the PR URL (kept in the description), and history becomes `events` with actor orchestrator; spec.md → `spec_md`; round-N/build.md → `rounds.build_md`, with diff.patch split into `round_files` by the 005 splitter and `base_sha` taken from the PR merge commit's first parent, else `unknown`; review-<r>.md → `verdicts` (first line verdict, rest body); decision.md → the approver decision on the last round; feedback-N.md → my CHANGES_REQUESTED on round N−1. Bootstrap transcripts from this repo's Claude Code project folder are stored the 030 way: subagents whose first prompt is `Job <id>, round <n>.`, teammate builders, and each /factory session that ran the job. `factory/jobs/` and `factory/board.json` go into .gitignore. `/factory approve` gets a last step `fctl import-factory --job <id>` that only warns if the app is down (.claude/skills/factory/SKILL.md).

jobs.title: Task bundle export and import
jobs.description: `GET /api/tasks/{id}/export` returns a zip in the 031 job-folder layout (spec.md, round-N/{build.md, diff.patch, review-*.md}, feedback-N.md, decision.md) plus `task.json` (title, description, status, stage, events, comments, import_key, no local paths). With `?transcripts=1` it adds the 030 transcripts, off by default because they can hold paths, env, and secrets. `POST /api/projects/{id}/import` takes the zip as the raw request body (no python-multipart) and reuses the 031 reader, keyed on import_key. It returns 413 over 50 MB, refuses entries with `..`, absolute paths, symlinks, or unknown names, and caps the total unpacked size (§4.5). Imported done and review tasks keep their status; anything else lands in Backlog with its history. `fctl export <id> [-o FILE] [--transcripts]` and `fctl import FILE` work against the current repo's project; Export goes on the task page and Import on the board.
